description: MARTINEZ RUIZ DE ARCAUTE, GONZALO and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The source analyses measured round-trip delays across regions and continents and compares them with the light-propagation baseline of conventional optical fibre. Coverage includes trends over the preceding decade, with persistent differences between countries. A companion study applies these real RTT observations to a hypothetical hollow-core-fibre scenario, distinguishing propagation delay from other delay sources. Potential reductions do not establish actual hollow-core deployment. The metadata do not identify a separate downloadable measurement dataset or full sampling frame. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
